# Japan Market Operator — Contract issue checklist

This is an operational issue list for preparing instructions to qualified counsel. It is not a binding contract or legal advice.

## Document set

- [ ] MSA / master terms
- [ ] Paid Market Validation SOW
- [ ] Japan Launch SOW, issued only after a Go decision
- [ ] Operator / revenue-share schedule
- [ ] KPI-conditional exclusivity addendum, if approved
- [ ] DPA, NDA, insurance certificate or specialist schedule where required

## Parties and authority

- [ ] Exact legal names, addresses, registration numbers and authorized signatories
- [ ] Brand ownership or license for every named SKU/trademark
- [ ] Territory, channels and cross-border sales treatment
- [ ] No conflict with existing distributor, agent, marketplace or license agreements

## Scope and acceptance

- [ ] Deliverables, dates, owners, approval SLA and client inputs
- [ ] Acceptance test and correction window for each deliverable
- [ ] Pause conditions, change request process and out-of-scope rate
- [ ] No sales guarantee, inventory purchase commitment or regulatory guarantee by Paradigm

## Product, import and consumer responsibility

- [ ] Manufacturer, seller of record, importer of record and tax/duty owner
- [ ] Classification, test, certification, label, instruction and claims owner
- [ ] Product warranty, returns, customer remedies and marketplace obligations
- [ ] Product liability insurance limits and evidence cadence
- [ ] Incident notice clock, regulator/insurer/counsel escalation and recall decision owner
- [ ] Recall, withdrawal, disposal, replacement, refund and communication costs

## Fees and evidence

- [ ] $5,000 validation invoice and 30-day launch credit rule
- [ ] $20,000 launch total and payment milestones
- [ ] $2,500 monthly retainer in advance
- [ ] 10% revenue share in arrears
- [ ] Net Collected Japan Sales formula and expressly permitted deductions
- [ ] Currency and FX source/date
- [ ] Monthly ledger fields, statement dates, objection window and correction method
- [ ] Record retention, evidence access and proportionate audit right
- [ ] Late payment, suspension, tax/withholding and bank/payment fees

## Exclusivity and performance

- [ ] Named SKUs, channels, customers and territory; all else carved out
- [ ] Activation date only after signed launch/operator terms and client commitments
- [ ] Quarterly sales target based on paid validation, not an unsupported pre-validation promise
- [ ] Brand inventory, media spend, approval and documentation commitments
- [ ] Paradigm reporting, channel execution, support and experiment commitments
- [ ] Measurement source, excluded events and dispute process
- [ ] Cure period, conversion to non-exclusive, sell-off and transition

## IP, data and accounts

- [ ] Client-owned deliverables versus Paradigm methods/templates/automation
- [ ] Trademark, product image, creator and localized-content licenses
- [ ] Marketplace, store, analytics, advertising and support-account ownership
- [ ] Personal-data roles, processors, cross-border handling, security and breach notice
- [ ] Export/return of data and credential revocation at exit

## Liability, termination and transition

- [ ] Liability cap and negotiated carve-outs
- [ ] Indemnities aligned to product/claims/IP/data/control responsibilities
- [ ] Term, renewal, ordinary termination and immediate termination events
- [ ] Open orders, returns, support, inventory, customer data and content handover
- [ ] Governing law, dispute escalation, venue/arbitration and language precedence

## Release gate

Contract may be sent only after:

- [ ] Commercial Lead confirms offer code and margin
- [ ] Delivery Lead confirms scope can be delivered
- [ ] Finance confirms payment and ledger mechanics
- [ ] Regulatory owner identifies specialist/counsel dependencies
- [ ] Authorized signatory approves deviations from the standard position
- [ ] Docuseal template/version and RevenueOS company ID are recorded
